item.title: This Day in New Jersey History — November 20: New Jersey becomes the first state to ratify the Bill of Rights
item.description: On November 20, 1789, New Jersey became the first state to ratify the amendments that became the Bill of Rights. Source: U.S. Senate / New Jersey State Archives
